how to seal a letter with wax
like the 1800s

2. melt the wax stick
over a flame

3. let a coin-sized pool drip
onto the fold

4. press the seal, count to ten,
lift it straight up

5. a little history

an unbroken seal proved
no one had read the letter.

6. write something worth sealing

i always have one new story
to tell.
